candidates.description: This vector represents the concept of motion pictures, filmmaking, and cinematic video media.
This feature vector represents visual and multimedia media content such as pictures, videos, and photographs.
This vector represents the concept of desires, intentions, and mental states regarding the future or hypothetical outcomes.
This feature vector activates on narrative elements, character roles, and storytelling concepts within a dramatic or fictional context.
This feature vector represents intensified adjectives and adverbs used to express striking quality, scale, or impact.
This feature vector activates on words and word fragments related to cognitive processes, perception, and mental grasping.
This vector is related to positive evaluations and enthusiastic praise.
This feature activates for verbs and action words related to entering, leaving, transitioning, or transforming.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to superheroes, comic book franchises, and the broader cinematic or pop-culture genre.
This feature vector represents the action and process of creation and manufacturing.
